nodes.title: Sciences, Engineering, Economics
nodes.electionNotes:
One of the eight profiles offered has to be selected. As a rule, the choice of the profile in SEE builds on the knowledge acquired in the previous bachelor’s program.

When specializing in SEE, the same profile has to be selected for the Specialization, too. No more than one SEE profile may be attended in the study program.

Important: "Computational Chemistry" is only offered in German. Fluent German language skills are obligatory. The other profiles can be studied in English.

nodes.electionNotes:
The Computational Chemistry profile is offered by the KIT Department of Chemistry and Biosciences. It includes modules and courses in German exclusively. Hence, very good knowledge of the German language is required for attending.

Selection of modules requires approval. Modules must be selected in consultation with the KIT Department of Chemistry and Biosciences, Prof. Marcus Elstner. In case of questions or trouble concerning approval please coordinate with Prof. Elstner and ask them to contact the Mathematics Student Center (Studierendenzentrum Mathematik).

Apart from the Obligatory Course (M-PHYS-101395 Physikalisches Fortgeschrittenenpraktikum / Advanced Physics Laboratory Course) other modules from the areas Computational Physics, Basic Physics Courses and Physics Technologies may be chosen freely. They are available both in SEE - Computational Physics as well as the Specialization SEE - Computatioal Physics. The Specialization in SEE - Computational Physics additionally offers a range of additional modules in an area Advanced courses.

A minimum of 16 credits must be chosen in total. The maximum number of credits is determined by the selected course loads in the other subjects with variable course loads.
